title: Bullet vs Prince Rupert's Drop at 150,000 fps - Smarter Every Day 165
summary: Smarter Every Day films a bullet hitting a Prince Rupert's drop with a high-speed camera at 150,000 fps. It shows how the glass drop's tough head and fragile tail behave on impact.
why: HN cites it as the go-to high-speed footage whenever Prince Rupert's drops come up.

quote.text: He also did a bunch of super slow-motion videos about shooting a Prince Rupert's drop with various firearms
